Name: Axatia's Brazier Retexture
Author: axatia
Description:
Exactly what it says on the tin.

Options:
- enabling/disabling individual textures for those who are attached to some of the vanilla designs 
- two colours of moss can be added to the stone brazier, one subtler & one bolder
- marble brazier can be faithful to vanilla blue, or it can be white to match the marble mineral sprite & real life marble carvings
- barrel brazier can have a top panel on it as a bonus for whoever would like a regular barrel item more than they would like a barrel-shaped torch. or you can have a regular barrel that is on fire. the world is your oyster!

For content patcher 2.9.1

Recolour featured in banner is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]

Manifest.Name: Axatia's Brazier Retexture
Manifest.Description: Makes the 8 brazier items more unique and thematic to their materials.
